主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. and Edward R. Grauch, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer, have entered into a Deferred Compensation Agreement dated December 29, 2019. Under the Agreement, Grauch has agreed to suspend 25% of his cash compensation for the 2020 calendar year in exchange for the Company accruing shares of common stock based on the fair market value of the stock. During 2021, the Company will distribute these shares to Grauch on the first business day following the close of each calendar quarter. In the event of a change of control, all further suspensions of cash compensation will cease, and Grauch will receive the fair market value of the accrued shares in cash as of the date of the change of control.
